lessons.title: JSX Basics
lessons.description: Learn how JSX lets you write HTML-like syntax in JavaScript.
lessons.instructions:
## JSX Basics JSX looks like HTML but lives inside JavaScript. Under the hood, `

Hello

` becomes `React.createElement('h1', null, 'Hello')`. ### Key Rules - Use `className` instead of `class` - Embed JavaScript expressions with curly braces `{}` - JSX must return a **single root element** (use `
` or `<>` fragments) - Self-closing tags must end with `/>` (e.g., ``, `
`) ### Your Task Create an `App` component that renders: 1. A `
` wrapper containing: - An `

` with the text **"Hello, React!"** - A `

` that displays the value of `const year = 2026` using a JSX expression - A `

` with `className="subtitle"` containing any text > **Hint:** Use `{year}` inside JSX to embed the variable.

challenges.title: The Frozen Counter
challenges.description: The counter displays but never updates when buttons are clicked.

challenges.title: The Infinite Loop
challenges.description: The component crashes or freezes immediately on mount.

challenges.title: The Stale Closure
challenges.description: Rapid clicks on the counter only increment by 1 total.

challenges.title: The Disappearing List
challenges.description: List items get jumbled when you delete from the middle.

challenges.title: The Instant Fire
challenges.description: Alert fires immediately on render, not on button click.

challenges.title: The Mutant Array
challenges.description: New items seem to be added but the list never updates on screen.

challenges.title: The Missing Cleanup
challenges.description: The timer speeds up every time the component updates.

challenges.title: The Conditional Hook
challenges.description: Component crashes with "Rendered more hooks than during the previous render".

challenges.title: The Slow Reply
challenges.description: A slow earlier fetch overwrites the result of a faster, more recent one.

challenges.title: The Wandering Edit
challenges.description: Editing an input and then reordering the list moves the edit to the wrong row.

challenges.title: The Lost Increment
challenges.description: A delayed update overwrites a more recent one, swallowing increments.

challenges.title: The Dropped Prop
challenges.description: A theme value is supposed to reach a deeply nested component but never arrives.

challenges.title: The Read-Only Input
challenges.description: A controlled input refuses to accept any typing.

challenges.title: The Restless Effect
challenges.description: A child’s useEffect re-runs every render, even when its dependency “hasn’t changed”.

challenges.title: The Page Reload
challenges.description: Submitting the form reloads the page and wipes all state.

challenges.title: The Lost This
challenges.description: A class component’s click handler throws because `this` is undefined.
